name: Lua Heap Cleaner & Optimizer
author: Sofia
description: Reduces UE4SS Lua heap bloat, GC stutter spikes, and stale UObject userdata crashes via frame-budgeted GameThread GC micro-stepping, generational collection, and world-transition heap flushes.

settings.label: Enable Lua Heap Cleaner
settings.tooltip: Master switch for the Lua Heap Cleaner and GC Pacer.

settings.label: Collector Strategy
settings.tooltip: StepPacer: Frame-budgeted micro-steps on the game thread (prevents 20-40ms GC freezes). Generational: Lua 5.4 generational GC for short-lived userdata. TunedIncremental: Tightened incremental GC.

settings.label: GC Step Interval
settings.tooltip: How often the GameThread GC pacer runs a micro-collection step (lower = smoother, more frequent micro-steps).

settings.label: GC Micro-Step Work Size
settings.tooltip: Maximum amount of work performed per incremental GC step interval.

settings.label: Post-Cycle Rest Threshold
settings.tooltip: After completing a full GC cycle, pause stepping until the heap grows by this many KB.

settings.label: Max Frame Time Budget
settings.tooltip: Maximum milliseconds allowed per GC step interval so garbage collection never causes a frame hitch.

settings.label: Heap Soft Cap (Emergency Flush)
settings.tooltip: If the Lua heap exceeds this threshold, forces a full garbage collection cycle to purge stale UObject wrappers.

settings.label: Flush Heap on World / Map Load
settings.tooltip: Immediately runs a full double GC cycle when changing worlds or returning to menu so dangling UObject pointers are freed before they can crash UE4SS.

settings.label: Periodic UE5 Engine GC Assist
settings.tooltip: Periodically calls Unreal Engine's KismetSystemLibrary::CollectGarbage on the game thread after flushing Lua userdata.

settings.label: Engine GC Assist Interval
settings.tooltip: Seconds between Unreal Engine CollectGarbage calls when Periodic UE5 Engine GC Assist is enabled.

settings.label: Log 60s Heap Telemetry
settings.tooltip: Writes a 60-second summary of Lua heap usage, GC step times, freed KB, and completed cycles to UE4SS.log.

settings.label: Verbose Debug Logging
settings.tooltip: Logs individual GC cycle completions, soft-cap flushes, and world transition cleanups.

settings.label: Force Heap Flush Hotkey
settings.tooltip: Press this key in-game to immediately run a full Lua heap collection and log freed memory.

settings.label: FORCE FULL HEAP CLEANUP NOW
settings.tooltip: Immediately executes a full double-pass Lua garbage collection cycle and logs memory before/after.

settings.label: LOG HEAP TELEMETRY SNAPSHOT
settings.tooltip: Prints current Lua heap size, peak heap, total freed memory, and GC latency stats to UE4SS.log.
